review_fragments.text:
<statechart version="0.2" initial="Waiting">
                <state id="Waiting">
                    <onentry>child_value(Value), output(nested(Value))</onentry>
                    <go to="Finished" on="finish" />
                </state>
                <final id="Finished" />
            </statechart>

/* Each chart owns these facts in its isolated Prolog datamodel.
       History contains complete user/assistant exchanges. pending/4 is
       only the in-flight request; failures never enter history. */
    :- dynamic history/1, pending/4, worker/1.
    history([]).

    valid_prompt(Text) :-
        string(Text), string_length(Text, N), N > 0, N =< 500.

    prepare(From, Ref, Text) :-
        history(History), append(History, [user(Text)], Messages),
        make_ref(Token), assertz(pending(Token, From, Ref, Messages)).

    /* Run the blocking capability in a linked adapter so SXML can still
       process reset, stop and timeout while inference is underway. The
       protected backend worker retains its slot even if we kill this
       adapter. Only the chart updates conversation history. */
    launch_model :-
        pending(Token, _, _, Messages), self(Self),
        spawn(( catch(model_chat(Messages, Result), error(_, _),
                      Result = error(model_unavailable)),
                send(Self, model_result(Token, Result))
              ), Pid, [link(true)]),
        assertz(worker(Pid)).

    stop_worker :-
        ( retract(worker(Pid)) -> exit(Pid, kill) ; true ).

    current_request(Token) :-
        pending(Expected, _, _, _), Token == Expected.

    valid_answer(Text) :-
        string(Text), string_length(Text, N), N =< 4000.

    remember_and_reply(Text) :-
        retract(pending(_, From, Ref, Messages)),
        append(Messages, [assistant(Text)], Complete),
        trim_history(Complete, Kept),
        retractall(history(_)), assertz(history(Kept)),
        From ! answer(Ref, Text).

    fail_request(Reason) :-
        ( retract(pending(_, From, Ref, _))
        -> From ! model_error(Ref, Reason)
        ; true ).

    clear_history :- retractall(history(_)), assertz(history([])).

    trim_history(History, Kept) :-
        length(History, Count), history_size(History, Size),
        ( Count =< 4, Size =< 1500
        -> Kept = History
        ; History = [user(_), assistant(_)|Rest], trim_history(Rest, Kept) ).

    history_size([], 0).
    history_size([Message|Rest], Size) :-
        arg(1, Message, Text), string_length(Text, N),
        history_size(Rest, Tail), Size is N + Tail.

report(From, Ref, Text, unavailable(Error), idle, none,
             retry_later, "Jev is unavailable; no state change was made.")

report(From, Ref, Text, Observation, idle, none,
